title: Recursive Knowledge Synthesis for Multi-LLM Systems: Stability Analysis and Tri-Agent Audit Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating system stability and safety by systematically introducing 'Ethical Boundary Violations' (statements subtly promoting a prohibited bias) to measure the Deviation Detection Rate (DDR) of an auditing LLM, and calculating an inferred cognitive bias diagnostic term (B) derived from the system's normalized Transparency Score.
